```{r}
library(auk)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
# library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(suncalc)
library(lutz)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(gridExtra)
library(readr)

if (!exists("params")) {
  params <- list(
    "prompt" = TRUE
  ) 
}
```

## Enter file names for the observations and sampling data:

```{r}
samplFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data/ebd_LA_2015-2025_all_spp_sampling.txt"
obsFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data/ebd_LA_2015-2025_all_spp.txt"


## This is where the filtered data will be saved to:
samplOut <- "data/ebd_LA_filtered.txt"
obsOut <- "data/ebd_LA_filtered_sampling.txt"
# obsFile <- "data/ebd_LA_data.zip"
# obsData <- read_ebd(unz(obsFile))

```

## Input your filter values. 

### Location

Input the range of latitudes/longitudes, or leave as is to use all data from the state.

```{r}
lonRange <- c(-94, -89.5) # Louisiana
latRange <- c(29, 33.5) # Louisiana

countrySelect <- c("US") ## country code
countryFull <- c("United States of America")
stateSelect <- c("LA")   ## state code
stateCodes <- sapply(stateSelect, function(x) paste(countrySelect, x, sep="-")) 

```

Then choose either "state" or "lat.lon" so R knows which values to filter by:

### Species

```{r}
sppSelect <- c("Wilson's Plover")

```

### Date

Leave as is if not filtering by date.

```{r}
dateStart <- "2015-01-01"
dateEnd   <- "2025-01-01"
```

## Filter both datasets.

If the filter looks correct, type "Y" at the prompt to get R to apply it and then combine the two datasets (type ?semi_join in the console to see what it does) to get rid of any checklists that don't appear in both places. 

```{r}

auk_ebd(file=obsFile, file_sampling=samplFile) |>
  auk_date(date=c(dateStart, dateEnd)) |>
  auk_species(species=sppSelect) |>
  auk_bbox(bbox=c(lonRange[1], latRange[1],lonRange[2], latRange[2])) |>
  auk_complete() |>
  auk_filter(file=obsOut, file_sampling=samplOut, overwrite=TRUE) 
  
```

# CREATE DETECTION/NON-DETECTION DATA

## Import the filtered data:

```{r}
obsData <- read_ebd(obsOut)
samplData <- read_sampling(samplOut)
print(str(obsData)) ## view a summary of the dataframe
```

## Zero-filling

To make these data into detection/non-detection data, we need to zero-fill them. Recall what zero-filling does from lecture. We end up with a column "species_observed", which has values of TRUE or FALSE.

***ANSWER***
Why does the sampling data have so many more rows than the observation data?

```{r}
det <- auk_zerofill(obsData, samplData, collapse=TRUE)
```


## Calculate time variables (might take a while).

```{r}

det <- det |> 
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(timeZone = "America/Chicago",
         start = as.POSIXct(paste(observation_date,time_observations_started, sep=" "), tz=timeZone), 
         end   = start + minutes(duration_minutes),
         year  = format(start, "%Y"),
         month = format(start, "%b"),
         date  = format(start, "%d-%b"),
         yearDay  = format(start, "%j")#,
        #  sunr  = getSunlightTimes(observation_date,latitude,longitude,tz=timeZone)$sunrise,
        #  minPastSunrise = as.numeric(round(difftime(start, sunr, units="mins")))
  ) 
```

## Calculate effort variables.

```{r}
# function to convert time observation to hours since midnight
time_to_decimal <- function(x) {
  x <- hms(x, quiet = TRUE)
  hour(x) + minute(x) / 60 + second(x) / 3600
}

det <- det |> 
  mutate(
    # convert count to integer and X to NA (ignore warning "NAs introduced by coercion")
    observation_count = as.integer(observation_count),
    # effort_distance_km to 0 for stationary counts
    effort_distance_km = if_else(protocol_type == "Stationary", 
                                 0, effort_distance_km),
    # convert duration to hours
    effort_hours = duration_minutes / 60,
    # speed km/h
    effort_speed_kmph = effort_distance_km / effort_hours,
    # convert time to decimal hours since midnight
    hours_of_day = time_to_decimal(time_observations_started),
  ) 
```

## Filter effort to get better comparisons.

```{r}
det <- det |>
    filter(protocol_name %in% c("Stationary", "Traveling"),
         effort_hours <= 6,
         effort_distance_km <= 10,
         effort_speed_kmph <= 100,
         number_observers <= 10)
det <- det |>
  select(checklist_id, observer_id,
         observation_count, species_observed, 
         state_code, locality_id, latitude, longitude,
         protocol_name, all_species_reported,
         observation_date, year, yearDay,
         hours_of_day, 
         effort_hours, effort_distance_km, effort_speed_kmph,
         number_observers)

```

# MAP THE DETECTION DATA

## Create map of the area you specified above (either latitude/longitude box, or state(s))

Prepare the GIS data & the observations:

```{r}
landMap <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_land") |> 
    st_geometry()
stProvBound <-  read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_state_lines") |> 
      st_geometry()
ctryBound <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_country_lines") |> 
      st_geometry()
studyArea <- read_sf("data/gis-data.gpkg", "ne_states") |> 
  # filter(state_code %in% stateCodes) |>
  filter(state_code == "US-AL") |>
      st_geometry()

detections_sf <- det |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) |> 
  select(species_observed)
```

```{r}

plTitle <- ""
bbox <- st_bbox(studyArea)
plot(st_geometry(detections_sf),
     xlim=c(bbox[3], bbox[1]),
     ylim=c(bbox[2], bbox[4]),
     main=plTitle, col=NA, border=NA)

plot(landMap, col = "#cfcfcf", border = "#888888", lwd = 0.5, add = TRUE)
plot(studyArea, col = "#e6e6e6", border = NA, add = TRUE)
plot(stProvBound, col = "#ffffff", lwd = 0.75, add = TRUE)
plot(ctryBound, col = "#ffffff", lwd = 1.5, add = TRUE)
yesColor <- "#4daf4a"
noColor <- "#998585"
plot(filter(detections_sf, !species_observed),
     pch = 19, cex = 0.2, col = alpha(noColor, 0.35),
     add = TRUE)
# observed
plot(filter(detections_sf, species_observed),
     pch = 19, cex = 0.3, col = alpha(yesColor, 1),
     add = TRUE)
# legend
legendTxt <- sprintf("Sighting of %s", spGrpName)
legend("bottomright", bty = "n",
       col = c(noColor, yesColor),
       legend = c("eBird checklist", legendTxt),
       pch = 19)
box()
```
